standard_scope: IEEE 1800-2017/2023 packed-array index, packed-struct field, and virtual-interface member expression semantics; full clause qualification remains open
root_cause: A two-dimensional netparray_t virtual-interface property fell through the generic netarray_t path. It selected the first packed rank at one struct width, then sent the remaining rank to apply_trailing_container_indices_, which reported an unrelated queue/associative-array sorry.
correction: Select each packed rank from the whole virtual-interface property with a typed NetESelect. Intermediate rows keep their remaining netparray_t dimensions; the final value keeps the declared netstruct_t type before field lookup. Each rank validates a simple integral index and is normalized and bounds-checked independently.
